{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float after removing commas
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_completed_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of real completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
